explanation.fa: با I بگو I have. برای پرسیدن تعداد، How many brothers and sisters do you have? را یاد بگیر. بعد از two، brothers با s می‌آید؛ بعد از one، sister بدون s است. only یعنی فقط.
explanation.en: Say I have. Learn How many brothers and sisters do you have? to ask a number. Use brothers after two but sister after one. Only means no more than this.

example.text: How many brothers and sisters do you have?

translation.fa: چند برادر و خواهر داری؟
translation.en: How many brothers and sisters do you have?

takeaway.fa: با how many تعداد را بپرس و با I have جواب بده.
takeaway.en: Ask with how many and answer with I have.

how many + things + do you have

explanation.fa: How old are your siblings? یعنی «خواهر و برادرهایت چندساله‌اند؟». siblings نام کوتاه‌تر brothers and sisters است. برای یک نفر بگو is ten years old؛ برای چند نفر از are استفاده کن.
explanation.en: How old are your siblings? asks their ages. Siblings means brothers and sisters. Use is ten years old for one person and are for more than one.

example.text: My brother is fourteen, and my sister is ten years old.

translation.fa: برادرم چهارده‌ساله است و خواهرم ده‌ساله است.
translation.en: My brother is fourteen, and my sister is ten years old.

takeaway.fa: برای سن از is یا are استفاده می‌کنیم، نه have.
takeaway.en: Use is or are for age, not have.

rows.text: my sister is ten years old

title.en: Saying two people are the same age

explanation.fa: the same age as یعنی «هم‌سنِ». پس از as، کسی را بگو که مقایسه می‌کنی: my sister. So در شروع این جمله یعنی «پس»؛ نیلوفر از سن گفته‌شده نتیجه می‌گیرد.
explanation.en: The same age as means equal in age. Put the other person after as: my sister. So here means that Niloufar is drawing a conclusion from the age she heard.

example.text: So your sister is the same age as my sister.

translation.fa: پس خواهرت هم‌سن خواهر من است.
translation.en: So your sister is the same age as my sister.

takeaway.fa: the same age as را یک عبارت کامل یاد بگیر.
takeaway.en: Learn the same age as as a complete expression.

title.en: Saying two people are the same age

rows.text: the same age as my sister

title.en: Getting along and doing things together

explanation.fa: get along well یعنی «خوب کنار آمدن»؛ با خواهرت از with your sister استفاده می‌کنیم. we study و we share کارهای معمول آن‌ها هستند. our secrets یعنی رازهای ما.
explanation.en: Get along well means have a good relationship. Add with your sister to say with whom. We study and we share describe usual activities. Our secrets means the secrets belonging to us.

example.text: Yes, we study together and we share our secrets.

translation.fa: بله، با هم درس می‌خوانیم و رازهایمان را با هم در میان می‌گذاریم.
translation.en: Yes, we study together and we share our secrets.

takeaway.fa: get along را با هم یاد بگیر، نه جداجدا.
takeaway.en: Learn get along together, not as separate literal words.

title.en: Getting along and doing things together

rows.text: get along well with your sister

title.en: Saying you wish things were different

explanation.fa: I wish ... did the same یعنی «کاش ... همین کار را می‌کردیم». نوید آرزو دارد او و خواهر و برادرهایش هم مثل نیلوفر با هم وقت بگذرانند. did اینجا نمی‌گوید قبلاً این کار را کرده‌اند؛ فعلاً کل جمله را یک الگوی آماده یاد بگیر.
explanation.en: I wish ... did the same expresses a different situation that Navid wants now. Did does not report that they actually did it before. Learn the whole sentence as a useful wish pattern.

example.text: That is great, I wish my siblings and I did the same.

translation.fa: عالی است؛ کاش من و خواهر و برادرهایم هم همین کار را می‌کردیم.
translation.en: That is great, I wish my siblings and I did the same.

takeaway.fa: I wish یعنی «کاش»؛ این جمله گزارش یک اتفاق واقعی نیست.
takeaway.en: I wish expresses a wish, not a report of something that happened.
